# PickMyApp

> Honest guides, comparisons and reviews of business software. We check vendor pricing pages, test free plans where possible, take no paid placements, and note the date every price was checked.

## Guides

- [Cloudflare Acquires Deno Explained: What It Means for Workers Developers and Self-Hosting (2026)](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/cloudflare-acquires-deno-explained/): On October 9, 2026, Cloudflare announced it is acquiring Deno and bringing Ryan Dahl's entire team in-house to merge Deno's open-source celld into Cloudflare's workerd runtime — making Workers self-hosting a first-class option. Deno runtime gets one year of maintenance, Deno Deploy shuts down in six months; Workers users change nothing, Deno users should plan migrations.
- [Anthropic Cyber Mission Explained: The Free Vulnerability Scanner for Open-Source Projects (2026)](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/anthropic-cyber-mission-explained/): On October 8, 2026, Anthropic announced something unusual for an AI lab: not a model, but a defensive cybersecurity program. The Anthropic Cyber Mission aims its AI at defenders — open-source maintainers and critical-infrastructure operators — to find and fix vulnerabilities before attackers do.
- [Activepieces vs n8n: Open-Source Automation Compared (2026)](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/activepieces-vs-n8n-open-source-automation/): Activepieces and n8n both charge per workflow run rather than per step and both can self-host, but they split on license (MIT vs fair-code), ease of use, and catalog depth — this guide compares pricing, pieces vs nodes, AI features, and self-hosting effort with real October-2026 numbers to tell you which fits your team.
- [ConvertKit Alternatives for Bloggers: 7 Email Tools Compared (2026)](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/convertkit-alternatives-for-bloggers/): A "which alternative fits YOUR kind of blog" comparison (not a head-on ConvertKit-vs-X piece): newsletter bloggers → Beehiiv/Substack/Ghost; affiliate bloggers → MailerLite/Brevo/Mailchimp; digital-product sellers → Ghost/Flodesk — with real October-2026 pricing, free plans, automations, migration and deliverability basics.
- [Best CRM for Freelancers and Solo Consultants (2026)](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/best-crm-for-freelancers-solo-consultants/): A solo-operator's guide to 8 CRMs (HubSpot free, Streak, Pipedrive, HoneyBook, Less Annoying CRM, Attio, Capsule, Folk) compared on real per-seat pricing, free plans, Gmail/Outlook sync, and invoicing — with the per-seat pricing trap solo users face.
- [ClickUp Pricing Explained: Is It Worth It in 2026?](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/clickup-pricing-explained-2026/): ClickUp costs $8 per user/month on Core and $17 on Business (billed annually), but the plan you actually need depends on limits most articles skip — 60 MB of storage on Free, lifetime feature "uses" that never reset, and limited guest seats on paid plans. For most small teams it is worth it: one subscription replaces two or three, but only if the whole team actually lives in it.
- [Best VPS Hosting for Developers Compared (2026)](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/best-vps-hosting-for-developers/): Six developer-focused VPS hosts compared on real October 2026 prices — from Hetzner's €5.49 CX23 to DigitalOcean's $24 Droplet — with an asymmetric developer-economics angle: transfer overages, snapshot costs, and API/CLI quality matter more than the sticker price.
- [ChatGPT Plus vs Claude Pro for Business Use (2026)](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/chatgpt-plus-vs-claude-pro-business/): Both plans cost $20 a month but serve different workloads — ChatGPT Plus is the generalist for web research, images, and high-volume prompting, while Claude Pro is the specialist for long documents, careful editing, and coding with Claude Code. Teams of two or more should upgrade to the team tiers for contractual no-training data guarantees.
- [Squarespace vs Shopify for Selling Online (2026)](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/squarespace-vs-shopify-selling-online/): Most comparisons ask which is the "best ecommerce platform" — the wrong question. This guide uses October 2026 pricing from the vendors' own pages and gives an asymmetric verdict keyed to catalog size and growth stage: Squarespace for small, design-led catalogs; Shopify when selling is the business.
- [Best Helpdesk Software for Ecommerce (2026)](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/best-helpdesk-software-for-ecommerce/): Compare the 7 best helpdesk tools for ecommerce in 2026 — Gorgias, Zendesk, Freshdesk, Re:amaze, Tidio, Richpanel, and eDesk — with real pricing checked in October 2026 and verdicts by store size and sales platform, from free chat for new stores to enterprise-grade ticketing.
- [IrisGo Explained: Free AI Workflow Assistant (2026)](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/irisgo-ai-workflow-assistant-explained/): IrisGo explained: the free AI workflow OS that topped Product Hunt on Oct 7, 2026. Watch & Learn, beta limits, pricing, and how it compares to n8n and Make.
- [Claude for Google Workspace Explained (2026)](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/claude-google-workspace-explained/): Claude for Google Workspace: Docs/Sheets/Slides sidebar, Gmail/Calendar access, pricing from $20/mo, and what small businesses should do next in 2026.
- [Make vs Zapier for Beginners: Which to Learn First](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/make-vs-zapier-beginners-which-to-learn/): Make vs Zapier for beginners: free plans, real 2026 prices (Make $9/mo, Zapier $19.99/mo), and which automation tool to learn first for common use cases.
- [Best Free Email Marketing Tools in 2026](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/best-free-email-marketing-tools-2026/): Free email marketing tools compared in 2026: Sender, Brevo, MailerLite, Mailjet, Mailchimp, Benchmark — real limits, send caps, automation and catches.
- [GoHighLevel vs HubSpot: Which Is Actually Worth It](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/gohighlevel-vs-hubspot-worth-it/): GoHighLevel vs HubSpot in 2026: $97-$497 flat-rate all-in-one vs per-seat CRM pricing, real costs with onboarding and usage fees, and who each is built for.
- [Notion vs Asana for Project Tracking](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/notion-vs-asana-project-tracking/): Notion vs Asana for project tracking in 2026: docs-plus-databases vs purpose-built tracking, real pricing per tier, and which team size each fits best.
- [Cloudways vs SiteGround for Agencies](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/cloudways-vs-siteground-agencies/): Cloudways vs SiteGround for agencies in 2026: white-label hosting, staging, client management and real pricing — $11/mo flat vs $29.99-$44.99 renewals.
- [Surfer SEO vs Frase for Content Optimization](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/surfer-seo-vs-frase-content-optimization/): Surfer SEO vs Frase in 2026: pricing from $39/mo vs $49/mo, content scoring, SERP analysis and AI writing compared — which suits freelancers vs teams.
- [Best Website Builder for Restaurants (2026)](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/best-website-builder-restaurants-2026/): Best website builder for restaurants in 2026: Wix, Squarespace, Toast and ChowNow compared on menus, ordering, reservations and pricing — $29/mo to $229/mo.
- [Intercom vs Crisp for Small Business](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/intercom-vs-crisp-small-business/): Intercom vs Crisp for small business in 2026: per-seat vs flat pricing, real costs for 5-person teams, Fin AI vs Crisp AI, and which live chat wins on budget.
- [Claude for Google Workspace Explained: What It Means for Small Business (2026)](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/claude-google-workspace-explained/): Anthropic put Claude inside Google Docs, Sheets and Slides in public beta on Oct 6, 2026. We explain what it does, what it costs from $20/mo, how it compares to Gemini, and what small businesses should do now.
- [IrisGo Explained: The Free AI Workflow Assistant for Solopreneurs That Topped Product Hunt (2026)](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/irisgo-ai-workflow-assistant-explained/): IrisGo for Solopreneurs finished #1 Product of the Day on Oct 7, 2026. We explain what the free AI workflow OS does, how Watch & Learn works, and how it compares to n8n and Make.
- [Make vs Zapier for Beginners: Which to Learn First](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/make-vs-zapier-beginners-which-to-learn/): Make vs Zapier for beginners: which is easier to learn, what the free plans really include, real 2026 prices (Make from $9/mo, Zapier from $19.99/mo), and which to learn first for your use case.
- [Best Free Email Marketing Tools in 2026](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/best-free-email-marketing-tools-2026/): The genuinely free email marketing plans of 2026, ranked by real limits: Sender's 15,000 emails a month, Brevo's 100,000-contact database, and how Mailchimp and MailerLite's shrunken tiers compare.
- [GoHighLevel vs HubSpot: Which Is Actually Worth It](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/gohighlevel-vs-hubspot-worth-it/): GoHighLevel and HubSpot aren't peer products — this guide prices both honestly (flat $97–$497 vs per-seat plus $1,500 onboarding) and shows which business model each actually serves.
- [Notion vs Asana for Project Tracking](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/notion-vs-asana-project-tracking/): Purpose-built tracking vs a docs workspace that tracks: real pricing per tier, views and workload compared, and which teams fit Notion or Asana.
- [Cloudways vs SiteGround for Agencies](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/cloudways-vs-siteground-agencies/): For agencies, hosting is a workflow decision, not a price one: Cloudways' flat $11/mo economics and cloning vs SiteGround's white-label client portal — with real renewal prices.
- [Surfer SEO vs Frase for Content Optimization (2026)](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/surfer-seo-vs-frase-content-optimization/): Freelancers get more from Frase's bundled briefs and AI writing ($39/mo annual); teams optimizing at volume get more from Surfer's deeper NLP scoring and audit tools.
- [Best Website Builder for Restaurants (2026)](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/best-website-builder-restaurants-2026/): Wix Core ($29/mo) is the best all-in-one for independents — commission-free ordering plus built-in reservations; Squarespace wins on design, Toast for POS-first restaurants, ChowNow for established brands.
- [Intercom vs Crisp for Small Business (2026)](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/intercom-vs-crisp-small-business/): Crisp's flat per-workspace pricing ($45–95/mo) beats Intercom's per-seat pricing ($29/seat) at small scale; Intercom wins for SaaS teams needing Fin AI and product messaging.
- [Gemini 4 Argon Explained: What Google's New AI Model Means for Small Business (2026)](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/gemini-4-argon-explained-small-business/): Google's Gemini 4 Argon has a 1M-token output limit and aggressive $2/$10 intro pricing — but only vetted cyber defenders can use it. Independent testing ties it with GPT-6 Astra, behind Claude Opus 5.5.
- [Bitdefender AI Guardian Explained: Protecting Your AI Agents from Manipulation (2026)](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/bitdefender-ai-guardian-explained/): A free macOS beta that sits between your AI agents and their tools, checking every action against your policy — allowed, flagged, or blocked. Built for Claude Code and OpenClaw users after research showed 36.5% attack success.
- [n8n Pricing Explained: Self-Hosted vs Cloud Costs (2026)](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/n8n-pricing-self-hosted-vs-cloud/): n8n Cloud vs self-hosted, worked out at three volumes: real 2026 prices, the execution model explained, and the exact point where a $5 VPS beats the €800 Business tier.
- [Brevo vs Mailchimp: Pricing and Features Compared](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/brevo-vs-mailchimp/): Brevo bills per email sent with unlimited contacts; Mailchimp bills per contact stored. See which costs less at your list size, plus free plans, automation, SMS and deliverability compared.
- [Pipedrive vs Monday CRM Compared](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/pipedrive-vs-monday-crm/): Pipedrive is the sharper selling tool with activity-based pipelines; Monday CRM is the more flexible, lower-priced work platform. This 2026 comparison breaks down per-seat pricing, features, and real team costs at 3, 10 and 25 seats to help you choose.
- [Trello Alternatives: 6 Kanban Tools Compared](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/trello-alternatives-kanban-tools/): Trello's 10-board free limit pushing you out? We compare six kanban tools — Asana, Monday.com, ClickUp, Notion, Jira, and Todoist — with 2026 pricing, free-plan limits, and a clear pick for every team type.
- [Hostinger vs Bluehost Compared Honestly](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/hostinger-vs-bluehost/): Hostinger beats Bluehost on both intro and renewal prices plus speed (LiteSpeed servers), while Bluehost wins on hand-holding: the WordPress.org recommendation and 24/7 phone support. Here is the honest math on renewals, upsells, and support.
- [Best AI Writing Tools for Small Business (2026)](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/best-ai-writing-tools-small-business-2026/): ChatGPT Plus or Claude Pro at $20/month is the best daily driver for most small businesses — add Jasper for team brand voice, Copy.ai for cheap team seats, Writesonic for SEO production, or Rytr for the tightest budgets.
- [WordPress vs Webflow for Freelancers (2026)](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/wordpress-vs-webflow-freelancers/): Webflow is the better daily tool for most freelance designers — visual CSS control, no maintenance, clean client handoffs. WordPress wins for content-heavy sites, deep plugins, and full ownership.
- [Zendesk vs Freshdesk for Startups (2026)](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/zendesk-vs-freshdesk-startups/): Freshdesk wins on value — a real free plan and $15/agent Growth vs Zendesk's $55/agent entry, with bundled rather than metered AI. Pick Zendesk for deep omnichannel complexity or its six-month startup program.
